label: Black Scarab estimated compensation
basis: advertised annual salary, excluding bonus and equity
method: One salary-range midpoint per distinct eligible requisition, then the median. No career-level pay bands inferred.
eligibility: U.S. engineering roles building robot-data capture, ingestion, storage, curation, annotation tooling or reusable ML datasets; complete annual USD ranges from structured ATS data or explicit annual source clauses.
limitations: Small selected-employer sample with mixed experienced roles. Excludes enterprise analytics, primarily fleet diagnostics/analysis, mixed people-management operations and unverified annual periods. Structured salary fields do not consistently identify base pay. Not a representative industry or entry-level salary.
